newsitem.title: USA: Rail heads to meet at Washington industry summit.
newsitem.headline: Rail heads to meet at Washington industry summit.

text.p: Top executives of the three big Eastern railroads trying to resolve a takeover stalemate will be in Washington for an industry meeting on Friday, but declined to comment on their planned takeover talks.

According to earlier announcements, among those to attend the quarterly conference of the American Association of Railroads will be David LeVan, the Chief Executive Officer of Conrail Inc, David Goode, the Chief Executive Officer of Norfolk Southern Corp, and John Snow, the Chief Executive of CSX Corp.

Association spokeswoman Carol Steckbeck said she assumed the three would hold their takeover meeting sometime after the conference, which ends at noon, but did not know where or when it might be held.
Both CSX and Norfolk Southern have made bids to buy Conrail, and the three executives on Wednesday announced the Friday meeting to try to resolve their takeover differences.
